let musicTimer=null,musicStep=0,musicStarted=false;
function getAudio(){audio??=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(audio.state==='suspended')audio.resume();return audio}
function tone(freq,dur,vol,type='sine',delay=0){if(vol<=0)return;try{let a=getAudio(),t=a.currentTime+delay,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,t);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(.0002,vol),t+.012);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+dur);o.connect(g).connect(a.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+dur+.03)}catch{}}
function startMusic(){if(musicStarted)return;musicStarted=true;musicTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(document.hidden||!state.musicVolume||document.getElementById('worldSelectOverlay')?.hidden===false||(typeof gzCueActive!=='undefined'&&gzCueActive)||document.getElementById('wheelLayer')?.classList.contains('on')||($('modal').classList.contains('show')&&($('sheriffScene')||$('moggedScene'))))return;let melody=[392,494,587,784,659,587,494,440,392,494,587,659,784,659,587,494],bass=[196,196,220,220,174.6,174.6,196,196];let v=state.musicVolume/100;tone(melody[musicStep%16],.17,v*.055,'triangle');if(musicStep%2===0)tone(bass[Math.floor(musicStep/2)%8],.25,v*.04,'sine');musicStep++},220)}

let manualTimes=[],manualIntervals=[],lastManualAttempt=null;
function clearAntiRuntime(){manualTimes=[];manualIntervals=[];lastManualAttempt=null;state.antiStrikes=0;state.antiUntil=0;}
function allowManualTap(e){
 if(!e.isTrusted)return false;
 const t=performance.now(),gap=lastManualAttempt===null?Infinity:t-lastManualAttempt;
 if(gap>2500){manualIntervals=[];manualTimes=[];}
 else if(gap>0){manualIntervals.push(gap);if(manualIntervals.length>60)manualIntervals.shift();}
 lastManualAttempt=t;manualTimes=manualTimes.filter(x=>t-x<1000);manualTimes.push(t);
 if(manualTimes.length>25)return false;
 if(manualIntervals.length>=40){const a=manualIntervals.slice(-40),avg=a.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/a.length,sd=Math.sqrt(a.reduce((x,y)=>x+(y-avg)**2,0)/a.length);if(avg<500&&sd<Math.max(2,avg*.012))return false;}

function royalCoronation(scene,track,onDone=()=>{},started=performance.now(),offset=0,onStop=()=>{},demo=false,spinTime=6000,resultText=''){
 let overlay=null,stage=null,rain=null,frame=0,closed=false,revealed=false,landed=false,beatIndex=-1,serial=0,audioSeen=false,failed=false,ended=false,previousFocus=null,observer=null;
 const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 function jewel(kind,id){const g='rfG'+id,h='rfH'+id;const defs=`<defs><linearGradient id="${g}" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#fff0bd"/><stop offset=".38" stop-color="#e9b354"/><stop offset=".72" stop-color="#9d5921"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f2ce82"/></linearGradient><radialGradient id="${h}" cx=".32" cy=".25" r=".8"><stop stop-color="#ffdfbd"/><stop offset=".36" stop-color="#d84a57"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#58152d"/></radialGradient></defs>`;let shape='';if(kind===0)shape=`<ellipse cx="31" cy="34" rx="24" ry="23" fill="#9e5f24"/><ellipse cx="29" cy="29" rx="24" ry="23" fill="url(#${g})" stroke="#f4d58e" stroke-width="2"/><ellipse cx="29" cy="29" rx="17" ry="16" fill="none" stroke="#a56b2a" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M19 34l-3-13 12 7 8-10 5 14z" fill="#b2742b"/>`;else if(kind===1)shape=`<path d="M7 20 20 7h24l13 13-25 36Z" fill="url(#${h})" stroke="#dba76b" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="m7 20 25 36-10-36L20 7m24 0-2 13-10 36m-25-36h50M20 7l12 13L44 7" fill="none" stroke="#f8c2a1" stroke-opacity=".7" stroke-width="1.4"/>`;else if(kind===2)shape=`<path d="M9 45 5 15l15 12 12-18 12 18 15-12-5 30Z" fill="url(#${g})" stroke="#eccc82" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M9 45h45v8H9Z" fill="#b47631" stroke="#f3d38c"/><circle cx="32" cy="35" r="5" fill="url(#${h})"/><circle cx="5" cy="14" r="3" fill="#e9ba67"/><circle cx="32" cy="9" r="3" fill="#e9ba67"/><circle cx="59" cy="14" r="3" fill="#e9ba67"/>`;else shape=`<path d="M11 16 23 7h28l4 12-13 35H6Z" fill="url(#${g})" stroke="#f4d59b"/><path d="M11 16h34l10 3M45 16 31 54" fill="none" stroke="#b77b39" stroke-width="2"/>`;return `<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">${defs}${shape}</svg>`;}
 function burst(n){if(reduced||!rain)return;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){if(rain.childElementCount>=90)break;const part=document.createElement('i'),side=(i+serial)%2;part.innerHTML=jewel(serial%4,serial++);part.style.setProperty('--x',(side?73+Math.random()*24:2+Math.random()*23)+'%');part.style.setProperty('--s',(21+Math.random()*30)+'px');part.style.setProperty('--dur',(2.3+Math.random()*1.6)+'s');part.style.setProperty('--delay',(Math.random()*.3)+'s');part.style.setProperty('--height',(60+Math.random()*35)+'dvh');part.style.setProperty('--drift',((side?-1:1)*(8+Math.random()*50))+'px');part.style.setProperty('--rot',((Math.random()-.5)*360)+'deg');rain.append(part);part.addEventListener('animationend',()=>part.remove(),{once:true});}}
 function mount(){if(overlay)return;previousFocus=document.activeElement;overlay=document.createElement('section');overlay.className='royal-fullscreen';overlay.id='royalCoronation';overlay.setAttribute('role','dialog');overlay.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');overlay.setAttribute('aria-label','Коронация');overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="rf-bg"></div><div class="rf-rays"></div><header class="rf-title"><h2>БУДУЩИЙ КОРОЛЬ</h2><p>${demo?'Предпросмотр коронации · коллекция не изменена':resultText||'Легендарный скин добавлен в коллекцию'}</p></header><div class="rf-stage"><img class="rf-throne" src="${royalThrone}" alt="Королевский трон"><img class="rf-king" src="${sonKingImage}" alt="Будущий король"></div><div class="rf-particles" aria-hidden="true"></div><button type="button" class="rf-close" disabled>Продолжить</button><button type="button" class="rf-skip">Пропустить</button>`;document.body.append(overlay);stage=overlay.querySelector('.rf-stage');rain=overlay.querySelector('.rf-particles');overlay.querySelector('.rf-close').onclick=finish;overlay.querySelector('.rf-skip').onclick=finish;overlay.querySelector('.rf-skip').focus({preventScroll:true});requestAnimationFrame(()=>{if(!closed&&overlay)overlay.classList.add('rise')});}
 function reveal(){if(revealed)return;mount();revealed=true;overlay.classList.add('rise','reveal');const btn=overlay.querySelector('.rf-close');btn.disabled=false;btn.focus({preventScroll:true});burst(18);}
 function tick(now){if(closed)return;if(scene&&!scene.isConnected){finish();return;}const wall=(now-started)/1000;if(track.currentTime>.02)audioSeen=true;const raw=ended?Math.max(8,track.currentTime):audioSeen&&!failed?track.currentTime:wall;const t=Math.max(0,raw-offset);
 if(!landed&&(t>=6||(spinTime===1000&&wall>=1))){landed=true;onStop();}
 if(t>=7)mount();if(t>=8)reveal();
 if(revealed&&!reduced&&!ended){const next=Math.floor((t-8)/.5);if(next>beatIndex){beatIndex=next;stage.classList.remove('rf-beat');void stage.offsetWidth;stage.classList.add('rf-beat');burst(7);}}
 frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
 function onEnded(){ended=true;if(!landed){landed=true;onStop();}reveal();}
 function onError(){failed=true;}
 function onKey(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&overlay){e.preventDefault();finish();}}
 function finish(){if(closed)return;closed=true;cancelAnimationFrame(frame);track.removeEventListener('ended',onEnded);track.removeEventListener('error',onError);document.removeEventListener('keydown',onKey);if(observer)observer.disconnect();track.pause();overlay?.remove();if(previousFocus?.isConnected)previousFocus.focus({preventScroll:true});onDone();}
 track.addEventListener('ended',onEnded);track.addEventListener('error',onError);document.addEventListener('keydown',onKey);frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);return finish;
}

 const scene=$('royalScene'),button=$('royalOpen'),note=$('royalNote'),pointer=$('royalPointer'),special=$('royalSpecial');let stopped=false,busy=false,angle=0,anim=null,timer=0,cleanupJack=()=>{},themeStarted=false,jackpotActive=false;
 function live(){return !stopped&&scene.isConnected&&$('modal').classList.contains('show');}
 function startTheme(){if(!live()||document.hidden)return;royalSetVolume(theme,true);if(!themeStarted){try{theme.currentTime=4;themeStarted=true}catch{theme.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',()=>{if(live()&&!themeStarted){try{theme.currentTime=4}catch{}themeStarted=true}},{once:true});}}royalSafePlay(theme);}
 function stopAll(list){list.forEach(a=>{try{a.pause();a.currentTime=0}catch{}});}
 function update(msg=''){if(!live())return;button.disabled=special.disabled=busy||!state.admin;button.textContent='Тест прокрутки';note.textContent=msg||'Админ-тест: без наград и изменения баланса.';}
 function stop(){if(stopped)return;stopped=true;clearTimeout(timer);if(anim)anim.cancel();cleanupJack();royalResetScene(scene);stopAll([theme,bells,track]);observer.disconnect();document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);}
 function visibility(){if(document.hidden){theme.pause();bells.pause();track.pause();}else if(live()){royalSetVolume(theme,true);royalSetVolume(bells);royalSetVolume(track,true);if(jackpotActive)royalSafePlay(track);else royalSafePlay(theme);}}
 const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{if(!live())stop();});observer.observe($('modal'),{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});observer.observe($('content'),{childList:true});document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);$('marketWheelBack').onclick=()=>{stop();openAdmin();};update();startTheme();
 function runTest(isSpecial){if(!live()||busy||!state.admin)return;busy=true;royalResetScene(scene);cleanupJack();jackpotActive=false;const sector=isSpecial?0:3,amount=isSpecial?null:0;button.disabled=special.disabled=true;note.textContent='Тест прокрутки…';royalSetVolume(theme,true);royalSetVolume(bells);royalSetVolume(track,true);try{bells.currentTime=0}catch{}royalSafePlay(bells);if(amount===null){jackpotActive=true;try{track.currentTime=0}catch{}royalSafePlay(theme);theme.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(state.muted?0:state.musicVolume/100)*.28));royalSafePlay(track);}else{royalSafePlay(theme);}const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;const sectorAngles=[0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315];const sectorAngle=sectorAngles[sector];const normalized=((sectorAngle-angle)%360+360)%360;const duration=reduced?0:rewardDuration(amount===null?6000:5200);const fullTurns=amount===null?7:5;const target=angle+fullTurns*360+normalized;const frames=amount===null?[{transform:`rotate(${angle}deg)`},{transform:`rotate(${angle+fullTurns*250}deg)`,offset:.55},{transform:`rotate(${target-16}deg)`,offset:.88},{transform:`rotate(${target}deg)`}]:[{transform:`rotate(${angle}deg)`},{transform:`rotate(${target}deg)`}];
 function finish(){if(!live())return;angle=target%360;pointer.style.transform=`rotate(${angle}deg)`;if(anim){anim.cancel();anim=null;}bells.pause();if(amount!==null){busy=false;update('Тест завершён · баланс не изменён');startTheme();}else{theme.pause();royalSetVolume(theme,true);note.textContent='Предпросмотр коронации';}}
 if(amount===null){if(pointer.animate){anim=pointer.animate([{transform:`rotate(${angle}deg)`},{transform:`rotate(${target}deg)`}],{duration,easing:'cubic-bezier(.12,.68,.18,1)',fill:'forwards'});anim.onfinish=null;}cleanupJack=royalCoronation(scene,track,()=>{cleanupJack=()=>{};jackpotActive=false;busy=false;if(live()){finish();update('Предпросмотр завершён · коллекция не изменена');startTheme();}},performance.now(),0,finish,true,duration);}else if(pointer.animate){anim=pointer.animate(frames,{duration,easing:'cubic-bezier(.12,.7,.13,1)',fill:'forwards'});anim.onfinish=finish;}else{timer=setTimeout(finish,duration);} 
 }
 button.onclick=()=>runTest(false);special.onclick=()=>runTest(true);
}
